act_name: AirCraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Short title, extent and commencement
title: Short title, extent and commencement
text:
1. Short title, extent and commencement. ⎯ (1) This Ordinance may be called the Aircraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

act_name: AirCraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Measures to avoid attraction of birds
title: Measures to avoid attraction of birds
text:
3. Measures to avoid attraction of birds. ⎯ (1) The Federal Government may by order require the owner or the person in possession or having the management or control of any tannery, slaughter-house, cattle-yard, fish-drying area, refuse-dump or other place within a specified area which attracts birds to take within such period as may be specified in the order such measures for avoiding attraction of birds which may endanger the safety of aircraft as may be so specified including closure of the source of such danger.

1 Approved by the National Assembly of Pakistan on the 16th July, 1965, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., pp. 567-569.
2 Subs. by Ord. X of 2001, s. 2.
3 Subs. by F.A.O, 1975, Art. 2 and Table, for “Central Government”.

(2) Any person affected by an order under sub-section (1) may, within thirty days following the order, make an application to the Federal Government for a review of the order on the ground that the measures directed to be taken are not necessary or that alternative measures described in the application would be equally effective for avoiding attraction of birds.

(3) The Federal Government may, after considering the application made under sub-section
(2) and giving the applicant an opportunity of being heard, modify, cancel or confirm the order made under sub-section (1).

act_name: AirCraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Restriction on construction or extension of tannery, etc
title: Restriction on construction or extension of tannery, etc
text: 5. Restriction on construction or extension of tannery, etc.  Within a specified area, no tannery, slaughter-house or cattle-yard shall be constructed, established or extended and no place shall be used for fish-drying or as a refuse-dump or for carrying on any trade or occupation which attracts birds except with the prior permission in writing of the Federal Government and in accordance with the terms and conditions, if any, on which the permission is granted.
raw_text:
5. Restriction on construction or extension of tannery, etc.  Within a specified area, no 
tannery, slaughter-house or cattle-yard shall be constructed, established or extended and no place 
shall be used for fish-drying or as a refuse-dump or for carrying on any trade or occupation which 
attracts birds except with the prior permission in writing of the 1[Federal Government] and in 
accordance with the terms and conditions, if any, on which the permission is granted.

act_name: AirCraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Power of entry in premises, etc
title: Power of entry in premises, etc
text: 6. Power of entry in premises, etc.  Any person authorised in this behalf by the Federal Government may at any time between sunrise and sunset enter and inspect any tannery, slaughterhouse, cattle-yard or fish drying area or any premises or land used as a refuse-dump or for carrying on any trade or occupation which may attract birds, for the purpose of ascertaining the extent of danger to the safety of aircraft caused by the attraction of birds and seeing whether the provisions of this Ordinance and any order or notification made or issued thereunder have been complied with.

act_name: AirCraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Penalty
title: Penalty
text: 7. Penalty.  Whoever fails to comply with or contravenes any of the provisions of this Ordinance or any order, direction or notification issued or made thereunder, or wilfully obstructs any person in doing any of the acts authorised by this Ordinance shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both, and in the case of a continuing offence, with an additional fine which may extend to five hundred rupees for every day after the first during which the offence continues.
raw_text:
7. Penalty.  Whoever fails to comply with or contravenes any of the provisions of this 
Ordinance or any order, direction or notification issued or made thereunder, or wilfully obstructs any 
person in doing any of the acts authorised by this Ordinance shall be punishable with imprisonment 
for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to 2[ten thousand] rupees, 
or with both, and in the case of a continuing offence, with an additional fine which may extend to 
2[five hundred] rupees for every day after the first during which the offence continues.

heading: Indemnity
title: Indemnity
text:
9. Indemnity. ⎯(1) No order made, notification issued or proceeding taken under this Ordinance shall be called in question in any court.
(2) No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against any person for anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Ordinance.
